metadata.description: A focus dashboard and a warm dark theme for Claude Code, built on one design system.

plugins.name: pomo
plugins.description: A focus dashboard beside the chat: a ring that burns down as the block runs, a parking lot for stray thoughts, your day and week at a glance, noise, chimes and logging to your Obsidian daily note.

plugins.name: ember-theme
plugins.description: A warm, dark-only theme for long sessions: quiet warm-neutral surfaces with one ember-orange accent. No blue anywhere.
